Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be played as long as it is a level 3 card with the [Beast] trait.
Card Q&A.q: Can my other Digimon that was returned to the hand by this card's inherited effect be played by this inherited effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 green or yellow level 3 Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By returning 1 of your other suspended Digimon to the hand, you may play 1 level 3 card with the [Beast] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
